items.title: dxil: eliminate giant-shader IR and CFG blowup in FormatLoad and multi-window memory

items.note:
Re-lands the PFSC (compressed PFS) decompression work from `6504565`, which was reverted after CI run #338 failed at Configure on all three platforms.

**Root cause of the CI failure:** the vendored `3rdparty/zlib` shipped `zconf.h.in` but not `zconf.h`. zlib's own `.gitignore` lists `/zconf.h` as a generated artifact, so `git add` silently skipped it. Local builds passed because the file existed on disk from the source tarball; CI's fresh clone died at `zlib/CMakeLists.txt:50` (`file(READ ${zlib_SOURCE_DIR}/zconf.h)` - no such file).

**Fix in this PR:**
- Track `3rdparty/zlib/zconf.h` (pristine upstream 1.3.2)
- Remove the `/zconf.h` rule f
